findings: 19節の構成を確認し、本編の作者名、役名札とセリフの区別、初回ウォーターマークと手動作画の保存、MCPのページ単位設定をUI・実装・ガイドに照合し、旧初期値の説明を更新した。
manualFindings: 3冊、全78ページの本文、用紙寸法、現行版番号を前版と比較。版表記以外の差分は全機能マニュアル19・45ページだけで、レンダリングを目視し、各冊の版番号も照合した。

pricingReview.findings: Standard text and image rates match the app, README and API guides for GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.2, GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Nano Banana 2.1. Batch rates were kept separate.

apiValidation.scope: The normal connected UI used GPT-6 Luna without model fallback for specified and unspecified role labels. Five speech entries and their speakers remained intact. No role-plaque instruction appeared in the ordinary prompt. With the two bundled references, GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst generated a five-panel comic, followed by the existing single bounded repair. The visible page retained scripted plaques and had no product footer. Two text-only generation requests returned unrelated imagery, were rejected by the existing review gate and were not saved. No cause on the provider side was established.
